about: 회계 II 추정자금월보(E020521) · 연보(E020522) — 다음 달 20일 입금 30,000 · 25일 출금 50,000 계획전표를 API 로 넣고 조회일자를 다음 달로 바꾸면 월보에 두 줄(잔액이 30,000 늘었다 50,000 준다) · '계획 합계' · '계', 연보 다음 달 열 자금증가 ≥ 30,000 · 자금감소 ≥ 50,000. 원본 2026-10-12 실측과 같은 흐름. 만든 장은 API 로 지운다.

shots.name: 준비 — 계획전표 둘(API)
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(() => { const n = new Date(); const ym = new Date(n.getFullYear(), n.getMonth() + 1, 15).toISOString().slice(0, 7); sessionStorage.setItem('ffym', ym); const tag = 'QA회계2 월보' + Date.now(); sessionStorage.setItem('fftag', tag); return Promise.all([window.__api('POST', '/fund-plans', { direction: 'IN', planDate: ym + '-20', method: 'DEPOSIT', amount: 30000, memo: tag + ' 입금' }), window.__api('POST', '/fund-plans', { direction: 'OUT', planDate: ym + '-25', method: 'NOTE', amount: 50000, memo: tag + ' 출금' })]).then((rs) => { sessionStorage.setItem('ffids', JSON.stringify(rs.map((r) => r.body.id))); return rs.map((r) => r.status).join(',') }) })()

shots.name: 월보 — 다음 달
steps: js:(() => { const ym = sessionStorage.getItem('ffym'); const set = (sel) => { const el = document.querySelector(sel); const d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value'); d.set.call(el, ym); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })) }; set('input[aria-label="조회 시작월"]'); set('input[aria-label="조회 끝월"]'); return ym })()

expect:(() => { const tag = sessionStorage.getItem('fftag'); const rs = [...document.querySelectorAll('table.ec-report tbody tr')]; const a = rs.find((r) => r.innerText.includes(tag + ' 입금')); const b = rs.find((r) => r.innerText.includes(tag + ' 출금')); if (!a || !b) return false; const v = (r, i) => Number(r.cells[i].innerText.replace(/,/g, '') || 0); return v(a, 3) === 30000 && v(b, 4) === 50000 && rs[0].innerText.includes('전월이월') && rs.some((r) => r.innerText.startsWith('계획 합계')) && rs[rs.length - 1].innerText.startsWith('계') })()

shots.name: 연보 — 다음 달 열
steps: expect:(() => { const ym = sessionStorage.getItem('ffym'); if (ym.slice(0, 4) !== String(new Date().getFullYear())) return true; const t = document.querySelector('table.ec-report'); const i = [...t.rows[0].cells].findIndex((c) => c.innerText === ym.replace('-', '/')); const row = (k) => [...t.rows].find((r) => r.cells[0].innerText === k); const v = (k) => Number(row(k).cells[i].innerText.replace(/,/g, '') || 0); return i > 0 && v('자금증가') >= 30000 && v('자금감소') >= 50000 && v('①자금의증가계') === v('회계증가') + v('자금증가') })()

js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status })); window.__api('POST', '/fund-plans/delete', { ids: JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('ffids')) }).then((r) => r.status)
